prompt: When an operator runs a rolling deploy with a short-lived access token and that token expires partway through, the deploy hangs silently. The readiness gate keeps polling a node that is actually healthy and surfaces nothing — no log line, no error — until the overall deploy timeout finally fires many minutes later. Make the deploy fail fast and surface the real cause instead of spinning. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: deploy readiness gate polling loop behavior
retry loop swallowing errors during node probe
how are Status RPC errors handled while waiting for ready
which failures should abort a deploy versus retry
_subject: entire-deploy: fail fast on auth errors instead of looping silently
